name: Diamond Blade
body:
School conjuration (creation) [earth]; Level magus 6, sorcerer/wizard 6

Casting Time 1 standard action

Components V, S, M (a diamond chip worth at least 10 gp)

Range personal

Target self

Duration 1 round/level (D)

Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance no

You create a glittering blade made of pure diamond. It becomes a weapon in the heavy blades or light blades weapon group for which you are proficient. You must have a free hand to cast this spell. The attack and damage statistics are of a +3 version of the weapon and all the attacks are touch attacks. Additionally, the diamond blade ignores up to 25 hardness. If you drop the weapon, the spell ends and is reduced to a fine glittering powder. The blade has a hardness of 25 and 50 hit points.
